About this item

  • ★ Protect Your Eyes With Style ▶ We created our polarized sunglasses men women to Protect your eyes while you are out under the harmful sun UV rays and to make you look Irresistible at the same time. Whether you are driving, walking or working, whether you are a man or a woman, prepare yourself for all the prime attention you can get and the admiration of all of those who can’t figure out your little secret: Your KALIYADI Sunglasses.
  • ★ Be More Relaxed Every Day ▶ Those sunglasses come with top rated polarized lenses that we tested over time. Polarization reduces glare reflected by mirrors, shiny or polished materials or any other kind of sun rays reflection. You will feel your eyes permanently relaxed because you will not squint anymore! Whether you are driving to work or having a nice sunbath on the beach, you will be less tired at the end of the day because your eyes are more relaxed.
  • ★ See The World In Its True Colors ▶ The HD polarized lens of our sunglasses mens offer true color perception because of the neutral color coating and clear vision by eliminating reflected and scattered light. Therefore you will be able to enjoy the sunglasses during all outdoor activities, driving, fishing or any water sport as well. Just imagine how good you will feel not having to worry about eyes health while being able to enjoy and admire the world in every beautiful detail.
  • ★ Move Free And Feel Free ▶ We know how uncomfortable frames can be and how this affects every wearer. We care about your vision and want to help you keep your sun glasses on for as long as you need them. Therefore we picked ultra-light materials for glasses frame, shatterproof polarized lenses and we took care so that every edge is smoothed and polished so you’ll even forget that you wear them out in the sun. Wearing sunglasses has never been more relaxing, secure and comfortable than now!
  • ★Brand Customer Service ▶ Classic sunglasses*2, microfiber pouch*2, microfiber glasses cleaning cloth*2. All KALIYADI customers enjoy brand customer service for our polarized sunglasses. The integrity of every box and the quality of the lenses are double checked by third-party companies.

What you can get


The quality of our KALIYADI Polarized Sunglasses differentiates us from competitors making those stylish shades stand out from the crowd. The pack contains:

  • Gift Box – protect your polarized sunglasses from pressure that can smash them
  • Dust Protection Pouch – avoid dust that can affect lenses over a long period of time
  • Microfiber Cleaning Cloth – help you clean your lenses without leaving marks or rubbing any particles of dust
  • Polarized Test Card – detect the polarizing effect of the lens

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers find these sunglasses to be good value for money and appreciate their appearance, with one noting they look expensive.     3 out of 5 stars
    Not Dark Enough
    Reviewed in the United States on April 11, 2022
    Color: B04-(2 Pack) Matte Black | Black | Silver Rim / Matte BlackLens Color: Multicoloured
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I’m a nocturnal creature, always have been. Naturally I am up until dawn, and only rouse at dusk. Being that I do 12 hour night shifts, I really don’t have a need “flip” my schedule, and can exclusively live the vampire life. I don’t know if it is cause or effect, but I’ve always been photosensitive as well. As a child, I didn’t realize that it wasn’t normal to squint constantly on a sunny day. I ruin every photo from the flash. I even get light-triggered debilitating migraines. I NEED my sunglasses.

    So after losing my second pair of Ray-Bans, I couldn’t stomach the cost knowing that I have a tendency to set things down and walk away absent mindedly. Most likely I had dropped them in a parking lot from my purse or hoodie pocket, as I had done in numerous occasions, documented by the scrapes and scuffs on the lenses. It’s just not practical for me to splurge on the item I never prioritized when juggling keys, phone, and bag.

    My first lost ones were black and silver Clubmasters which I’ve had a hell of a time replacing in those classic colors, much less the polarized ones. I really missed how stylish they were. Then my classic Wayfarers disappeared. In scoping out to actually buy new Clubmasters, did I come across this package deal with both styles and super affordable. I wouldn’t feel shame about my treatment of sunglasses at this price point.

    When I received them I was super impressed. They were a little lighter weight, but overall seemingly sturdy and nice quality. Superb style, I wouldn’t be ashamed of not wearing designer. So I threw them in my bag to leave for work in the evening, to keep one in the car and save one for my purse.

    The next morning leaving work, it was nice and bright outside, and after a long shift, it is just the worst to be tired and blinded on a congested commute home. As soon as I hit the exit, I whip out my new glasses, and noticed I still had some eye strain, chalking it up to physical fatigue. Drive home, same thing. The next day I used the other glasses, and it again felt too bright. It only then occurred to me that these are not as dark as I was used to with my Ray Bans.

    I gave it a few more days, and realized these just don’t seem to make a difference for me. Feels like I’m wearing nothing at all. (Nothing at all, nothing at all…) Taking them on and off, I feel as if there is barely a difference, like they’re a placebo.

    I had focused so much on getting polarized, I forgot how the most crucial part of sunglasses is the darkening effect. They appear to be dark when you look at them, so it’s kind of an odd thing, and why it took me a day or so for it even to click with me with what was wrong.

    These are so weak, I feel like the polarized effect didn’t even do much for glare. I can even see clearly LCD displays that I couldn’t see previously even with other discount brands, so I’d say even this feature isn’t as good as it could be.

    Perhaps these may be useful in other sporting uses that people wear these glasses for, or could even be tinted enough for some, but absolutely not for me. If you’re truly dependent on eye protection and can’t leave the house without them like me, just keep looking.
